remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x601)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE
    -DCOM_NO_WINDOWS_H)

spec2def(msxml6.dll msxml6.spec)
add_typelib(msxml6_tlb.idl)

# msxml6.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msxml6-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(msxml6_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(msxml6_shims PRIVATE wine libmsxml3 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
set_wine_module(msxml6_shims)
add_dependencies(msxml6_shims stdole2)
add_cargo_module(msxml6 msxml6-cargo msxml6.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msxml6_shims psdk ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/msxml6_tlb.tlb)
